exposure: gestational weight gain (above, less than, or recommended by guidelines)
cohort: The study included 13,060 women in Belgium with singleton pregnancies complicated by gestational diabetes, delivering between 38-40 weeks gestational age.
finding: This study suggests that optimal gestational weight gain for singleton at-term pregnancies complicated by gestational diabetes should be lower than current recommendations to minimize combined risks of SGA and LGA infants.
mod_finding: Gestational weight gain above recommended guidelines was associated with an increased risk of emergency caesarean section (aOR 1.45, 95% CI 1.25-1.69).
